title: Recruitment coordinator- Contract Role
description:
**Company Description**
Aarohaan Sales and Services was founded with the purpose of providing specialized services in focused business sectors, helping companies and small businesses grow in specific areas of their operations. The organization believes in partnering for long-term success rather than short-term prospects, working on end-to-end cycles to reduce effort for clients. Aarohaan collaborates closely with small firms to support and accelerate their business growth. Its service portfolio includes recruitment and hiring, channel partnership, product sales and services, and personnel management, offering clients integrated support across key business functions.

**Role Description**
The Recruitment Coordinator – Contract Role will support the full recruitment lifecycle for roles across Aarohaan’s client base and internal teams. This contract position is hybrid, based in the Pune District, with a mix of on-site work and some work-from-home flexibility. Day-to-day responsibilities include sourcing candidates through various channels, screening resumes, coordinating interviews, maintaining applicant tracking records, and supporting offer and onboarding processes. The role also involves regular communication with hiring managers and candidates, preparing recruitment-related documentation, and assisting with reporting on hiring activities and timelines. The Recruitment Coordinator will collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth, timely, and inclusive hiring process aligned with client requirements and organizational standards.

**Qualifications**

* 2 years experience in recruitment coordination or talent acquisition support, including candidate sourcing, resume screening, and interview scheduling.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle multiple open positions, maintain accurate records, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to engage with candidates, hiring managers, and external partners in a professional, inclusive manner.
* Proficiency with basic office productivity tools and applicant tracking systems or recruitment platforms; ability to learn new tools quickly.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation, reporting, and data entry related to recruitment and personnel management.
* Understanding of general hiring practices and basic employment-related processes; prior exposure to recruitment or HR in sales and services sectors is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a hybrid model from Pune District, managing both on-site and remote responsibilities independently.
* Relevant educational background such as a degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

title: Lead Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
  
  
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
UKG is looking for a Lead Talent Acquisition Partner in Pune to drive value-driven hiring for its product, technology & G&A organization, partnering with senior global leaders across region. This is a senior individual contributor role for a professional who combines strong stakeholder management, talent market intelligence, and hands-on expertise in AI-enabled recruiting to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Lead TA Partner owns hiring outcomes for a global portfolio of roles spanning product, engineering, and G&A functions. The role operates as a strategic partner to senior leaders across regions, translating business priorities into hiring plans, advising on talent market trade-offs, and ensuring every hire creates value for the business.
  
  
The Lead TA Partner also leads recruiting projects that change how the global team works: piloting and scaling AI-enabled tools and automation, embedding structured and repeatable processes, and bringing data storytelling into leadership conversations. The role serves as a go-to resource for the team on stakeholder management, market insights, and AI in recruiting, and is expected to lead complex, business-critical searches with confidence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive value-driven, end-to-end hiring for global product, engineering, and G&A roles, delivering on time, on quality, and aligned to business goals.
* Act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to senior leaders across the region, aligning hiring priorities, challenging assumptions, and guiding decisions on market trade-offs, compensation positioning, and location strategy.
* Manage complex, multi-region stakeholder groups with confidence, adapting approach across time zones, hiring cultures, and business contexts.
* Lead recruiting projects and initiatives end to end, from scoping and stakeholder buy-in through adoption and impact measurement, in areas such as AI sourcing and screening pilots, structured interviewing, intake and SLA frameworks, and hiring manager enablement.
* Evaluate, pilot, and scale AI-enabled tools and automation across sourcing, screening, scheduling, candidate engagement, and reporting, with measurable gains in turnaround time and recruiter capacity, while safeguarding fairness, candidate experience, and data privacy.
* Build and nurture proactive global talent pipelines for critical and recurring skills; identify alternative talent pools, geographies, and adjacent profiles when traditional sources cannot meet demand.
* Provide leaders with timely talent market intelligence on availability, skill scarcity, compensation benchmarks, and the competitive landscape, and use it to shape hiring strategy and long-term workforce plans.
* Use funnel data, systems reporting, and market insights to influence hiring decisions; act as the team's trusted advisor in data storytelling and translate insights into clear, compelling narratives for leadership.
* Develop a strong understanding of UKG's products, customers, and the HCM industry, and connect recruiting strategies clearly to business and team priorities.
* Identify and implement process improvements that raise hiring speed, quality, interview consistency, and the experience for candidates and hiring managers.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and team resource on process, tooling, AI, and stakeholder management; coach peers through challenging situations and reinforce best practices across the global team.
* Lead complex, niche, or business-critical searches where role ambiguity or talent scarcity requires a customized approach.

**Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with a substantial portion in SaaS, enterprise software, or product-led technology companies.
* Proven experience partnering with and advising senior stakeholders across global, distributed teams and multiple time zones, with a strong record of stakeholder management and influence.
* Demonstrated track record of value-driven hiring outcomes: quality of hire, offer-acceptance, hiring manager satisfaction, and time-to-fill for product and technology roles.
* Hands-on expertise using AI in recruitment, such as AI-assisted sourcing, candidate matching and screening, outreach personalization, interview intelligence, or generative AI for recruiting content and analysis, with the ability to articulate measurable impact and lessons learned.
* Experience leading recruiting projects or initiatives end to end, from defining scope and securing buy-in through adoption and measurement.
* Strong data and business acumen; comfortable with funnel metrics, dashboards, and market data, and able to turn them into a persuasive story for leaders.
* Deep knowledge of modern sourcing techniques, global talent market mapping, and competitive intelligence for technology talent in India and internationally.
* Proficiency with enterprise ATS and CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and recruiting analytics tools.
* Excellent communication, consulting, and influencing skills; able to challenge thinking constructively and operate with a high degree of autonomy.
* Preferred: experience recruiting for HCM, HR tech, or workforce management products; exposure to global hiring programs, employer branding, or talent intelligence; experience mentoring recruiters.

**Company Overview**
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.
  
  
UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.
  
  
Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process
  
  
For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
**Company Description**
RS Consulting is a specialist recruitment firm with over 17 years of experience helping organizations hire better and faster. The company combines proven research methodologies with deep market knowledge to identify candidates for hard-to-fill and strategic roles. RS Consulting partners closely with clients to understand their talent challenges and deliver tailored search solutions. The firm is focused on quality, speed, and long-term fit, offering a collaborative environment for recruitment professionals who want to refine their expertise and grow their careers.

**Role Description**
The Executive Recruiter role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division. The Executive Recruiter will manage end-to-end recruitment for senior and niche positions, including role scoping, candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and managing the offer process. This role involves developing and maintaining talent pipelines, conducting market and industry research, and leveraging multiple channels such as professional networks, job boards, and social platforms to identify high-caliber candidates. The Executive Recruiter will collaborate closely with clients and internal stakeholders to understand hiring needs, provide consultative insights, and ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. The position also includes maintaining accurate recruitment data, preparing search reports, and contributing to continuous improvement of search strategies and processes.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer negotiation for senior and specialized roles.
* Ability to conduct structured research on industries, roles, and talent pools, and to use data and insights to inform search strategies.
* Proficiency in using recruitment tools and platforms (ATS, LinkedIn, job boards, CRM systems) and leveraging professional networks for talent acquisition.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage both clients and candidates professionally.
* Solid organizational and time management abilities, with attention to detail and the capacity to handle multiple searches simultaneously.
* Experience in executive search or specialized recruitment is highly beneficial; prior work in consulting or professional services is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in recruiting.
* Commitment to fair, inclusive, and non-discriminatory hiring practices, and to maintaining confidentiality and integrity in all interactions.

title: Senior Team Leader - Human Resources
description:
**Senior Team Leader - Human Resources, India**

**Pune, India · Work from office · Leads a team of Junior HR Generalists**

**About CloudLex**

CloudLex is a leading cloud based legal technology platform for litigation firms in the United States. Headquartered in New York, with engineering, product, and marketing in Pune, India. Reaching 300 professionals globally. Backed by prestigious venture capital and growth private equity, including Aligned Capital, Rosepark Advisors, and The Riverside Company.

**We run two centers in India. The technology division is in Pune., MH. The services division is in Jabalpur, MP. This role covers both. ~100 in Pune and ~200 in Jabalpur.**

**Your Role**

**Run recruitment for both divisions**

* Plan roles and budget with the business leaders in tech and services dvision
* Manage the entirerecruitment process from sourcing to onboardig
* Run the offer stage: negotiate, issue the letter, start background verification, and close
* Manage recruitment consultants where you use them, including fees and quality

**Run campus recruitment for Pune and Jabalpur**

* Build and maintain the list of target institutes for both cities, with a named contact at each
* Call and visit placement officers, and build the relationship before you need the slot
* Negotiate placement dates and slots, and get on the calendar early enough to matter
* Organize pre-placement talks end to end, including panel, travel, material, and logistics
* Run the on-campus test and interview process on the day
* Run the internship program operationally, from intake through the pre-placement offer decision
* Organize hackathons and campus events, including budget, vendors, and the people who will attend

**Lead a team of HR Generalists**

* Set weekly priorities and run a weekly review on open positions
* Coach them on screening, on closing candidates, and on the conversations they find hard
* Review their work rather than assume it, especially on offer letters and candidate communication
* Spend time at Jabalpur Service Center in person on a regular basis, including short stints. The company pays for it

**Run the employee lifecycle**

* Run onboarding: documentation, induction schedule, asset and system access coordinated with IT, and a first week that is planned before the person arrives
* Run the appraisal cycle end to end: calendar, forms, manager chasing, normalization discussions, and letters out on schedule
* Handle resignations, run exit interviews, and coordinate full and final settlement
* Keep HRMS records, leave data, and personnel files accurate for both offices
* Coordinate statutory requirements such as provident fund and state insurance with the finance team

**On experience, read this carefully**

1. 5 to 8 years in HR
2. Of which at least 3 years must be spent directly managing a team, with people reporting to you and their performance your responsibility
3. Total years in the profession is not the measure. We will ask who reported to you, for how long, what you were accountable for, and what you did when one of them was not performing

**Must have**

* Hands-on recruitment ownership, not oversight of a process somebody else ran
* Campus recruitment you can evidence: institutes, programs, numbers
* Experience hiring for more than one kind of role. This job is technical hiring and operations hiring both
* Practical use of AI tools in your own work. Not awareness. Use
* Appraisal and lifecycle processes run end to end
* Experience managing people you do not sit with every day
* Working knowledge of an HRMS and of Indian statutory requirements
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to hold a position with senior leadership

**Compensation**

Fixed compensation of 9 LPA to 14 LPA depending on experience

Based in Pune, work from office

Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer inthe interim. As we build the department we will seek senior leadership at director and vice president level

description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.
  
  
**About The Role**
The focus of this role will be to support, maintain and continuously enhance DNV’s global HR application landscape and participate in GSS IT projects and initiatives related to HR processes.
  
  
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will work closely with the HR community, IT teams and external partners, ensuring alignment between business requirements, application capabilities and the overall DNV system landscape.
  
  
DNV utilizes Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud across several HR processes, together with related PaaS services and other integrated HR solutions. For this position, we are particularly looking for strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), combined with broader hands-on experience across Oracle Fusion HCM.
  
  
The position combines application management, functional and technical consulting, configuration, integrations, operational support and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute both to stable day-to-day operations and to initiatives further developing our global HR technology landscape.
  
  
Be part of our long-term journey to continuously develop and improve the global HR IT landscape at DNV.
  
  
**As An Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, You Will**

* Ensure stable, reliable and well-performing Oracle Fusion HCM applications and services.
* Provide functional and technical application support, including analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex application issues.
* Configure, maintain and continuously improve Oracle Fusion HCM functionality based on business requirements.
* Analyze HR business requirements and translate them into appropriate functional and technical solutions.
* Support integrations between Oracle Fusion HCM and other internal and external systems.
* Work with REST APIs, HCM Data Loader (HDL), SQL and other relevant Oracle HCM technologies for integrations, data management, troubleshooting and application maintenance.
* Coordinate with Oracle and other vendors on incidents, product issues, enhancements and technical topics.
* Communicate and collaborate with HR users, stakeholders and other IT teams across the organization.
* Provide consulting to the HR business regarding application capabilities, enhancements and future development of HR processes and IT solutions.
* Execute and manage configuration enhancements and technical changes based on new or evolving business requirements.
* Contribute to Oracle Fusion HCM release management, including impact assessment, regression testing and review of relevant release documentation.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure alignment of solutions and services within the broader GSS IT application environment and DNV system landscape.
* Maintain appropriate functional and technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the HR Applications team.

**Why this role matters**
Our HR application landscape supports critical HR processes globally. As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will contribute directly to the stability, development and continuous improvement of these solutions.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of HR processes, Oracle Fusion HCM and technology, helping translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting the continued evolution of DNV’s global HR technology landscape.

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**
**Must have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud, including application configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement.
* Strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), including configuration and integrations with other systems.
* Hands-on experience with additional Oracle Fusion HCM areas such as Core HR, Compensation,
* Benefits, Security, Talent or other HCM modules.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL).
* Experience working with REST APIs and system integrations.
* Experience with SQL for analysis and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of end-to-end HR business processes and their implementation within HR technology solutions.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective functional and technical solutions.
* Experience with standard IT application support processes, including incident, request and change handling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently take ownership of topics and drive them through to completion.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple activities and deliver against agreed timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, functions and organizational boundaries.
* Willingness to continuously learn and keep up with changes within the Oracle Fusion HCM platform.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Oracle HCM reporting, extracts and related integration technologies.
* Experience with Oracle PaaS services and extensions.
* Experience participating in Oracle Fusion HCM implementations, rollouts or major enhancement initiatives.
* Experience working within a global HR technology or enterprise application environment. Personal qualities

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**

* Is self-driven, proactive and well organized.

title: Recruiter
description:
We are seeking an energetic and results-driven Automobile Dealership Recruiter to lead talent acquisition for our growing dealership group. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and hiring top-tier automotive professionals—ranging from high-performing sales consultants to certified service technicians. You will partner closely with the General Manager and department heads to keep our dealership fully staffed with talent that drives sales and delivers exceptional customer service.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Dealership Talent Sourcing: Proactively source active and passive candidates for critical dealership roles, including Sales, Service & Support functions.
* High-Volume Recruiting: Manage high-volume recruitment cycles, particularly for sales and service departments, ensuring a continuous pipeline to minimize empty floor slots or open service bays.
* Technical & Trade Outreach: Build relationships with local automotive trade schools, technical colleges, Professional courses college, ITI etc
* Hiring Manager Collaboration: Partner with the General Manager, Service Director, and Sales Managers to understand seasonal hiring spikes, technical certification requirements, and personality alignments for the floor.
* Screening & Assessment: Review resumes, conduct initial phone screenings, and evaluate candidates for key automotive traits like strong communication, work ethic, technical aptitude, and clean driving records.
* Brand Ambassadorship: Promote the dealership’s culture, commission structures, and growth paths

* Active Headhunting: Map local and regional competitors to directly source and approach passive talent, including top-producing Sales Consultants and Finance & Insurance (F&I) Managers.
* Technical Service Pipeline Sourcing: Build and maintain direct pipelines for skilled labor by recruiting from independent repair shops, competing OEM dealerships, and establishing relationships with automotive trade schools & colleges.
* Digital Sourcing Strategies: Utilize advanced Boolean search strings, LinkedIn Recruiter, specialized automotive networks, Facebook Jobs, and local community forums to uncover hidden talent pools.
* Grassroots & Local Networking: Attend local car shows, automotive trade expos, and community job fairs to build a physical network of prospective dealership talent.

* Employee Referral Programs: Drive and optimize internal referral campaigns to leverage the personal networks of our current technicians, mechanics, and sales staff.

Requirements
  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* Experience: 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience. Experience in the automotive retail or dealership sector is highly preferred (or experience in high-turnover industries like retail, hospitality, or commission-based sales).
* Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with dealership-specific compliance requirements
* Tech-Savvy: Experience working with specialized job boards

Benefits
  
  
1. Statutory benefits
  
2. Incentives

title: Recruiter / Sr. Recruiter (6 months)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
At OpenGov, finding the right people to drive revenue and deliver for our customers starts with a great sourcing engine. As a Recruiter / Sr. Recruiter, you’ll be the first point of contact for candidates pursuing roles in India — building pipelines, sparking conversations, and qualifying talent before passing it to the recruiting team.
**Based in Pune on a 6-month contract,**
you’ll partner closely with our TAs to keep hiring moving fast, especially during high-volume hiring drives where interview coordination becomes just as critical as the outreach itself. If you’re energized by the hunt, love a great candidate conversation, and take pride in keeping things organized and on-time, this role is for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Source candidates proactively using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and creative outbound tactics — identifying both active and passive talent that matches the profile for each requisition.
* Conduct initial phone and video screens to assess candidate interest, communication quality, compensation expectations, and basic role fit before passing qualified candidates to the Recruiter.
* Maintain a healthy, organized pipeline on Ashby, keeping candidate records, outreach status, and screen notes updated so the recruiting team always has a clear view of where candidates stand.
* Coordinate interview scheduling during hiring drives — managing candidate and interviewer calendars, sending confirmations, and ensuring a smooth, on-time interview experience for all parties.
* Draft and send personalized outreach messages to passive candidates that reflect OpenGov’s mission and the opportunity at hand, balancing volume with authenticity to maximize response rates.
* Collaborate daily with the Recruiter, sharing pipeline updates, flagging blockers, and aligning on sourcing priorities as requisition needs shift.
* Serve as a positive brand ambassador in every candidate interaction, ensuring that even candidates who aren’t a fit walk away with a strong impression of OpenGov.
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of sourcing or talent acquisition experience in a SaaS, technology, or staffing environment, or equivalent work experience
* Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one ATS platform for pipeline tracking and candidate management
* Strong written communication skills — able to craft outreach that gets responses and represents the brand well
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage candidate pipelines and interview schedules simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience sourcing GTM talent specifically in the Indian market, with familiarity with the Pune talent landscape and local compensation norms
* Prior experience with Ashby or a similar ATS
* Background in high-volume or hiring-drive environments where speed and coordination are equally important
* Familiarity with GovTech, enterprise SaaS, or public sector software — helpful context for qualifying candidates on role and mission fit

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

* Monitor adherence to company policies, code of conduct, and disciplinary procedures.

* Assist in preparing and updating KRAs, KPIs, and performance tracking sheets in coordination with reporting managers.

* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
Qualys is seeking an experienced and highly strategic
**Principal Recruiter**
to join our Global Talent Acquisition team.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Talent Acquisition, this is a senior individual contributor role responsible for leading some of the company's most critical and high-impact hiring initiatives globally.
  
  
This position is designed for a recruiter with deep expertise in executive search, talent intelligence, market mapping, and complex global hiring. The successful candidate will partner closely with senior leaders and executives to attract exceptional talent across technical and non-technical functions while helping shape hiring strategies that support the long-term growth of the business.
  
  
This is not a high-volume recruiting role. It is an opportunity to focus on strategic hiring, solve complex talent challenges, and influence business outcomes through exceptional talent acquisition expertise.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for business-critical, highly specialized, and difficult-to-fill positions across Qualys globally.
* Partner directly with executives, senior leaders, and hiring managers to develop and execute effective talent acquisition strategies.
* Drive complex searches across technical and non-technical functions, including Engineering, Product Management, Cybersecurity, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
* Develop and execute innovative search strategies for niche, emerging, and highly competitive talent segments where traditional recruiting approaches may be insufficient.
* Build and maintain strategic talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs through proactive sourcing, talent mapping, networking, referrals, market research, and competitive intelligence.
* Conduct organizational mapping, competitor analysis, and talent market research to identify and engage exceptional talent globally.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on talent availability, hiring strategy, compensation trends, market dynamics, and competitive talent landscapes.
* Influence hiring decisions through data, external market insights, and talent intelligence.
* Partner with stakeholders to define hiring requirements, assessment approaches, and candidate evaluation criteria to ensure high-quality hiring outcomes.
* Engage, assess, and attract high-caliber candidates across a broad range of functions, disciplines, and experience levels.
* Own candidate engagement and offer closure, effectively managing competing offers, compensation expectations, relocation considerations, and complex negotiations.
* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while acting as a brand ambassador for Qualys.
* Leverage recruiting technologies, AI-enabled tools, and talent intelligence platforms to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and hiring outcomes.
* Champion best practices in strategic recruiting, executive search, talent mapping, candidate assessment, and stakeholder management.
* Partner with recruiters and recruiting leaders globally on critical hiring initiatives and particularly challenging searches.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness, quality of hire, recruiting efficiency, and candidate experience.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications :
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 12+ years of recruitment and executive search experience, with a demonstrated track record of hiring senior leadership and business-critical talent across multiple functions and geographies.
* Significant experience recruiting across both technical and non-technical functions.
* Proven success hiring for highly specialized, niche, and difficult-to-fill roles.
* Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, market intelligence, competitive research, and strategic sourcing.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align talent acquisition strategies to business objectives.
* Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
* Experience supporting hiring across multiple global regions and talent markets.
* Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and successfully lead complex searches from strategy through closure.
* Experience leveraging Applicant Tracking Systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-powered recruiting tools, and talent intelligence platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within cybersecurity, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, AI, or other high-growth technology environments.
* Executive search firm or retained search experience.
* Experience recruiting for leadership, specialist, technical, and go-to-market functions on a global scale.
* Strong understanding of global talent markets and competitive hiring landscapes.

title: Services Architect II
description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
  
  
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
The role of the Services Architect is responsible for consulting with clients to analyze and understand the client's business needs and create a services solution to meet those requirements. This position will be the focal point for effective communications with the client/prospect for the development of a services solution.
  
  
The Services Architect is expected to maintain a thorough knowledge of UKG’s services and practices and work with each service line to create and coordinate the proposed solution and pricing. The Services Architect will be responsible for driving revenue by evaluating, product positioning, and selling the optimal services components for the client. The Services Architect will be the single point of contact for sales and clients for services opportunities.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Partner with the UKG Sales organization and designated Services Architects line of business to pursue and close services opportunities
* Provide a single point of contact to Sales and Services Delivery for services opportunities
* Develop an understanding of each target customer’s business, operations, and industry trends
* Understand the customer’s strategic business and technology goals and create the proposed service approach and solution
* Drive the sales process to completion coordinating all Services resources and documentation such as proposals, SOW’s, RFP responses, etc
* Track critical sales and pipeline data on opportunities using existing systems
* Maintain a pipeline and communicate it to Strategist, Sales and Services Delivery management
* Contribute to the improved efficiency of the sales function by participating in the development and deployment of appropriate services sales tools/templates
* Grow services revenue by interacting with all levels of customer management and proposing solutions that provide business benefit
* Participate in Rapid Improvement Team Involvement

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3-5+ years in a professional services role, ideally 3+ years in application software implementation and/or services sales
* Advanced knowledge and understanding of HCM, WFM, Scheduling, Leave Management, or similar domain product/systems required
* Previous experience with customer presentations, developing SOW’s, responding to RFP’s, estimating projects, and negotiating contracts
* Ability to develop and manage complex Services solutions for small to medium business to Enterprise level organizations
* Well versed in Launch implementation methodology with experience defining project requirements, managing project engagements, developing project plans, etc
* Ability to travel up to 25% as needed

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ready Product experience strongly preferred
* Develop good working relationships with staff in Services and Sales organizations
* Ability to be engaged in the art of consultative selling and negotiating techniques
* Intermediate presentation skills with the ability to effectively articulate the services value proposition as part of the overall business solution
* Ability to effectively communicate and negotiate with C-Level executives in an “influence without authority” role
* Understands the impact and implications of political, social, economic, technological, and competitive trends on UKG and customer organizations
* Working knowledge of nuances of the small to medium business to Enterprise-level business space preferred
* B.A. / B.S. degree, with a focus in business or Information technology preferred

**Company Overview**
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.

title: Contract Recruiter (6 months)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
At OpenGov, finding the right people to drive revenue and deliver for our customers starts with a great sourcing engine. As a Contract Recruiter focused on GTM, you’ll be the first point of contact for candidates pursuing Sales and Professional Services roles in India — building pipelines, sparking conversations, and qualifying talent before passing it to the recruiting team. You will also support other functions like Engineering, Product, and Security when needed, while keeping the primary focus on GTM hiring.
**Based in Pune on a 6-month contract,**
you’ll partner closely with our TAs to keep hiring moving fast, especially during high-volume hiring drives where interview coordination becomes just as critical as the outreach itself. If you’re energized by the hunt, love a great candidate conversation, and take pride in keeping things organized and on-time, this role is for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Source candidates proactively using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and creative outbound tactics — identifying both active and passive talent that matches the profile for each requisition.
* Conduct initial phone and video screens to assess candidate interest, communication quality, compensation expectations, and basic role fit before passing qualified candidates to the Recruiter.
* Maintain a healthy, organized pipeline on Ashby, keeping candidate records, outreach status, and screen notes updated so the recruiting team always has a clear view of where candidates stand.
* Coordinate interview scheduling during hiring drives — managing candidate and interviewer calendars, sending confirmations, and ensuring a smooth, on-time interview experience for all parties.
* Draft and send personalized outreach messages to passive candidates that reflect OpenGov’s mission and the opportunity at hand, balancing volume with authenticity to maximize response rates.
* Collaborate daily with the Recruiter, sharing pipeline updates, flagging blockers, and aligning on sourcing priorities as requisition needs shift.
* Serve as a positive brand ambassador in every candidate interaction, ensuring that even candidates who aren’t a fit walk away with a strong impression of OpenGov.
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency.

**Requirements**
Requirements and Preferred Experience
  
  

* 5+ years of sourcing or talent acquisition experience in a SaaS, technology, or staffing environment, or equivalent work experience
* Demonstrated ability to source and engage candidates for GTM functions such as Sales (SDRs) or Professional Services (Implementation Engineers)
* Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one ATS platform for pipeline tracking and candidate management
* Strong written communication skills — able to craft outreach that gets responses and represents the brand well
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage candidate pipelines and interview schedules simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience sourcing GTM talent specifically in the Indian market, with familiarity with the Pune talent landscape and local compensation norms
* Prior experience with Ashby or a similar ATS
* Background in high-volume or hiring-drive environments where speed and coordination are equally important
* Familiarity with GovTech, enterprise SaaS, or public sector software — helpful context for qualifying candidates on role and mission fit

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

Human Resources & Administration

title: Human Resources Director
description:
**Company Description**
Power Works Engineering specializes in the manufacturing, engineering, design, and supply of flow control equipment and piping systems for nuclear power plants.

**HR Director (HRD)**

**Manufacturing | Maharashtra, India**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced HR Director to build and lead the HR and administration function for a new valve manufacturing facility in India.

You will define the people strategy, build the workforce, and establish the policies, systems, and compliance framework required for plant launch and long-term operations. The role combines strategic leadership with direct operational responsibility during the initial stages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **HR strategy & workforce planning:**

  Translate business and production plans into workforce requirements, organizational structure, and manpower budgets.
* **Recruitment & onboarding:**

  Lead hiring across engineering, production, quality, technical, and administrative roles. Build recruitment partnerships, apprenticeship programmes, and effective onboarding.
* **Compliance & employee relations:**

  Oversee labour and statutory compliance, contractor obligations, employee relations, grievance handling, and disciplinary processes.
* **Compensation & HR operations:**

  Establish salary structures, benefits, payroll controls, and systems for employee records, attendance, and leave.
* **Performance & development:**

  Implement performance management, KPIs, training, and competency management aligned with business needs and applicable ISO requirements.
* **Culture & engagement:**

  Build a culture of safety, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.
* **Plant administration:**

  Oversee facilities support, security, housekeeping, canteen, transport, administrative vendors, and related budgets. Coordinate expatriate support where required.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including leadership responsibility in manufacturing or industrial facilities in India.
* Proven ability to establish or scale HR functions, policies, and systems.
* Strong expertise in Indian labour legislation, plant-level statutory compliance, industrial relations, and contract labour management.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting engineering professionals, production teams, and skilled workers.
* Experience managing HR budgets, compensation, payroll, and performance processes.
* Experience in an international organization with structured governance and reporting.
* Familiarity with competency management and HR requirements in ISO-certified or audited environments.
* Strong business judgment, stakeholder management skills, and willingness to work hands-on.
* Fluency in English and Marathi.

**Preferred:**

Greenfield plant experience; background in engineering, energy, nuclear, oil & gas, aerospace, or other quality-regulated industries; experience supporting expatriates; employee training experience; relevant degree or postgraduate qualification.

**What We Offer**

The opportunity to shape the plant’s people strategy and build its HR function from the ground up, working with international management from project launch through full-scale operations.

**How to Apply**

Please send your CV to info@pwe-uae.com with the subject line
**“HR Director — [Your Name]”**

.

In your email, briefly describe one example of an HR function or key HR process you personally built or significantly improved. Please include:

* The business challenge and scale of the organization.
* Your specific role and actions.
* The measurable results achieved.

Please keep your response to
**150–200 words**

.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
Lead - Talent Acquisition (Corporate)

Department: Human Resources (Talent Acquisition)

Location: Pune / Corporate Office

Experience: 8-12 Years

Qualification: MBA / Post Graduate Degree in Human Resources or related discipline.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition professional to lead end-to-end recruitment operations for white-collar positions across manufacturing, automotive, and auto-component businesses. The role will be responsible for driving recruitment strategy, manpower fulfillment, sourcing effectiveness, recruitment cost optimization, vendor governance, offer management, recruitment analytics, and process compliance while ensuring an excellent candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. End-to-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete hiring lifecycle from manpower requisition approval to candidate onboarding.
* Partner with business leaders and HR stakeholders to understand manpower requirements and workforce plans.
* Drive timely closure of open positions within agreed hiring TATs and quality parameters.
* Coordinate interviews, assessment processes, selection decisions, and joining formalities.
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.

2. Recruitment Budgeting & Cost Optimization

* Prepare and manage the annual recruitment budget aligned with workforce planning.
* Monitor recruitment expenditure and cost-per-hire metrics.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives through effective sourcing channel utilization.
* Ensure adherence to approved recruitment budgets and provide periodic spend analysis.

3. Strategic & Low-Cost Talent Sourcing

* Develop efficient sourcing strategies through job portals, social media, employee referrals, ATS databases, networking, and alternate sourcing channels.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Continuously evaluate source effectiveness and improve hiring productivity.
* Reduce dependency on external agencies through strong direct sourcing initiatives.

4. Offer Management & Candidate Engagement

* Manage offer approvals, offer roll-out, and candidate communication.
* Conduct salary negotiations within approved compensation frameworks.
* Monitor offer acceptance ratios, drop rates, and joining conversions.
* Implement actions to improve candidate engagement and joining success.

5. Vendor Management

* Identify, empanel, and manage recruitment partners in line with company policies.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs, quality standards, and turnaround times.
* Negotiate commercials and optimize vendor utilization.
* Ensure governance, compliance, and performance reviews of recruitment partners.

6. Recruitment MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate recruitment MIS and dashboards.
* Track key recruitment metrics including:
* Time to Fill (TTF)
* Turnaround Time (TAT)
* Cost Per Hire
* Source Effectiveness
* Offer-to-Join Ratio
* Pipeline Health
* Generate periodic reports and insights for HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Analyze hiring trends and recommend process improvements.

7. Process Compliance & Governance

* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, SOPs, audit requirements, and internal controls.
* Maintain proper recruitment documentation and records.
* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of recruitment processes.
* Identify risks, gaps, and opportunities to enhance recruitment effectiveness.

8. Recruitment Technology & Systems

* Drive effective utilization of ATS, Sense Platform, and SAP SuccessFactors.
* Ensure data accuracy, system hygiene, and reporting integrity.
* Support stakeholder training and adoption of recruitment technologies.
* Leverage analytics and automation to improve hiring outcomes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Hiring TAT Achievement
* Position Closure Rate
* Cost per Hire
* Offer-to-Join Ratio
* Source Effectiveness
* Recruitment Budget Adherence
* Vendor Performance & SLA Compliance
* Candidate Experience Metrics
* Recruitment Data Accuracy

Desired Experience

* 8-12 years of Talent Acquisition experience in Automotive, Auto Component, Manufacturing, Engineering, or Industrial organizations.
* Strong experience in hiring for Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D, and Corporate functions.
* Proven expertise in recruitment budgeting, sourcing strategy, and vendor management.
* Experience managing recruitment MIS, dashboards, and HR analytics.
* Hands-on exposure to ATS platforms, SAP SuccessFactors, Sense AI sourcing tools, or similar technologies.
* Experience handling audits, recruitment governance, and policy compliance.

title: US IT Recruiter
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a US IT Recruiter who can independently own end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for US-based IT staffing requirements (C2C / W2 / 1099, contract and full-time), while also supporting domestic (India) and UK requisitions during general working hours. You'll work closely with the TA Lead, account managers, and vendors to source, screen, and close niche IT positions across technology stacks, and will need to flex your working hours when US client requirements demand overlap with US time zones.

**Shift & Work Hours**

This role follows a General Shift of 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM IST, working from our Bhopal office. During this shift, you will primarily work on domestic (India) and UK requirements.

* When active US requirements come in, you are expected to adjust your working hours to align with the relevant US time zone overlap for sourcing, screening, and candidate/client coordination on those roles.

* Outside of active US requirement windows, you will continue working the General Shift (10:30 AM – 7:30 PM IST) on domestic and UK requisitions.

* Shift adjustments for US requirements will be communicated in advance by the TA Lead based on client urgency and hiring manager availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end recruitment lifecycle — requisition intake, sourcing strategy, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closure — for assigned US IT, domestic, and UK requisitions.

* Source active and passive candidates through job boards (Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn Recruiter), Boolean search, referrals, and vendor/partner networks for US IT roles.

* Understand and work confidently with US tax terms and engagement types (C2C, W2, 1099) and immigration/work-authorization basics (H1B, GC, USC, OPT/CPT, TN) relevant to US IT staffing.

* Conduct L1 screening interviews to assess technical fit, communication, rate/compensation alignment, and work-authorization status before submitting candidates to hiring managers or clients.

* Manage a portfolio of P0–P3 priority requisitions simultaneously across US, domestic, and UK accounts, balancing urgency and quality across roles.

* Partner with account managers, hiring managers, and clients to clarify job requirements, calibrate candidate expectations, and troubleshoot sourcing bottlenecks.

* Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in the ATS (e.g., Zoho Recruit) — candidate status, tags, and stage movement.

* Coordinate and manage vendor/staffing partner submissions, ensuring quality and turnaround SLAs are met, including rate negotiations on C2C submissions.

* Drive offer/rate negotiation and compensation discussions in line with approved budgets, escalating gaps between market rate and approved budget where needed.

* Provide timely, structured updates to the TA Lead on requisition status, blockers, and forecasted closures.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of TA processes — screening forms, submission trackers, and interview scheduling workflows.

* Mentor and support junior recruiters on US IT sourcing techniques, screening rigor, and pipeline hygiene.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5–9 years of experience in recruitment, with a strong, demonstrable background in US IT staffing (C2C / W2 / 1099).

* Proven track record of closing niche or hard-to-fill US IT roles within agreed SLAs, working with clients and implementation partners/vendors.

* Strong sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, Boolean search, and referral networks.

* Solid working knowledge of US tax terms, work-authorization categories, and typical US IT staffing submission/rate processes.

* Hands-on experience with an ATS (Zoho Recruit, Greenhouse, or similar) and comfort maintaining structured pipeline data.

* Excellent stakeholder management skills — confident working directly with hiring managers, clients, and vendors across US, UK, and domestic accounts.

* Willingness and flexibility to adjust working hours for US time-zone overlap as needed, in addition to the standard General Shift.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience recruiting for BFSI, AI/ML, or technology client accounts in the US market.

* Familiarity with vendor management and staffing partner ecosystems (implementation partners, prime vendors).

* Exposure to recruitment analytics, dashboards, or reporting tools.

description:
**Specialities** 
 \- Digital transformation, AI\-driven engineering, cloud\-native platforms, and enterprise software solutions, with strong focus on hi\-tech, telecom, retail, and manufacturing industries.
 



  





**Position – Sr Software Engineer** 




**Experience Required: 6 Years \+** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong experience in C\+\+ with Infoscale with Linux kernel development, kernel crash analysis, enterprise storage systems, and volume management. The ideal candidate should have excellent C/C\+\+ programming skills and hands\-on experience debugging kernel panics, analyzing vmcore dumps, and fixing complex bugs in kernel, storage, and volume management components. Experience with porting and supporting solutions across RHEL 8\.x to 9\.x kernel changes is highly desirable.

* **Develop and maintain Linux kernel, storage, and volume management components.**
* **Investigate kernel panics, OOPS, system hangs, and crash dumps.**
* Perform root cause analysis and implement bug fixes.
* Debug and optimize storage I/O path, file system, and volume manager issues.
* Port and validate kernel\-dependent code across RHEL 8\.x and RHEL 9\.x.
* Work on kernel modules, device drivers, and Linux internals.
* **Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve customer issues.**
* Mentor junior engineers and participate in design reviews.








**Required Skills** 



* **Strong C/C\+\+ systems programming**
* **Linux Kernel Development**
* **Infoscale**
* **Linux Internals (memory management, scheduling, synchronization)**
* **Kernel Crash Analysis (kernel panic, OOPS, vmcore)**
* **Kernel Debugging and Bug Fixing**
* Kernel Porting across RHEL 8\.x to RHEL 9\.x
* Understanding of critical kernel API and subsystem changes between RHEL 8\.x and 9\.x
* Debugging tools: crash, KGDB, GDB, perf, ftrace
* **Storage Systems and Storage I/O Path**
* Volume Management (LVM, Veritas Volume Manager / VxVM)
* File Systems: EXT4, XFS, NFS, Veritas File System (VxFS)
* **Root Cause Analysis and Troubleshooting**

title: Fresher BBA and BMS
description:
**Company Description** 
 Avalanche High\-Tech Enterprise is a comprehensive online platform that integrates recruitment services, IT solutions, and product development to support diverse business needs. The organization connects employers with suitable talent through advanced matching tools, covering permanent, contract, and specialized consulting roles. Its IT services range from system integration and cloud solutions to cybersecurity and software development, helping clients optimize processes and improve efficiency. Avalanche High\-Tech Enterprise also focuses on innovative IT product development, creating software applications, mobile apps, and digital solutions that enhance customer experience and operational performance.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for BBA and BMS freshers based in Pune City. The role involves supporting recruitment operations through candidate sourcing, initial screening, and maintaining databases, while assisting with coordination between hiring teams and applicants. Team members will help with basic documentation, data entry, and preparation of reports related to recruitment and IT projects. They may also contribute to market research, process documentation, and internal communication to ensure smooth collaboration between the recruitment, IT services, and product development teams. The position is designed to provide structured training, mentorship, and exposure to cross\-functional business activities within a high\-tech environment.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Completed or pursuing a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) or Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) from a recognized institution.
* Strong foundation in business administration and management principles, including basic HR, marketing, and operations concepts.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and comfort working with online platforms and databases.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks under guidance and supervision.
* Willingness to learn about recruitment processes, IT services, and product development workflows in a technology\-focused environment.
* Ability to work on\-site in Pune City and collaborate effectively in a team\-oriented setting.
* Internship or academic project experience in HR, recruitment, IT services, or business analysis is an advantage but not mandatory.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Minimac Systems Pvt. Ltd., incorporated in 2012 and registered as an MSME under NSIC, is a leading provider of end\-to\-end lubrication reliability solutions. The company offers technical consulting, training, services, and manufacturing of systems for oil purification, filtration, flushing, OEM filter replacements, and oil testing devices, along with Minimac Operations \& Maintenance Services (MOMS). Guided by a strong focus on Clean Tech and ESG, Minimac leverages IoT and AI tools to enable data\-driven maintenance and reliability decisions. With a growing global presence across Asia, the Middle East \& Caspian, North Africa, South\-East Asia, and Australia, Minimac is committed to decarbonizing the lubricant life cycle and delivering high\-quality, timely solutions that create customer joy and empower people.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Recruitment Specialist role based in the Pune Division. The Recruitment Specialist will manage the end\-to\-end hiring process, including sourcing candidates, screening resumes, coordinating and conducting interviews, and supporting selection decisions in collaboration with hiring managers. The role involves maintaining candidate pipelines, updating recruitment trackers, and ensuring a positive, inclusive candidate experience. The Recruitment Specialist will also assist with onboarding activities, coordinate training schedules for new hires, and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment practices aligned with the company’s values and growth objectives.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Recruiting and Hiring skills to manage end\-to\-end talent acquisition.
* Candidates should possess effective Interviewing and Communication skills to assess fit and engage with candidates and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Training and onboarding support skills to help new hires integrate smoothly into the organization.
* Relevant experience in recruitment, HR, or talent acquisition within technical or industrial domains is beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, manage multiple requisitions, and meet hiring timelines.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HR databases, and standard office productivity tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

title: TA Ops Sr. Executive
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Operations Specialist to lead and manage the end\-to\-end offer management process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence across hiring activities. Based in Pune with a hybrid working model, this role is responsible for offer letter creation, candidate data and document validation, governance of recruitment systems and processes, audit readiness, reporting, and continuous process improvement. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining compliance with organisational policies while delivering a high\-quality candidate experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own and manage the end\-to\-end offer creation process for lateral and internal recruitment activities
* Ensure accurate validation of candidate documentation and data in line with organisational policies and compliance requirements
* Create and issue offer and appointment letters within agreed service levels and quality standards.Maintain governance and compliance within recruitment systems, ensuring data accuracy and process adherence
* Produce weekly and monthly operational dashboards, including offer creation performance, first\-time\-right metrics, and process exceptions
* Act as the custodian of offer\-related documentation and ensure effective handover to the onboarding team
* Support internal and external audit requirements by maintaining accurate records and documentation
* Identify opportunities for process enhancement and support the implementation of efficiency improvements
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Talent Acquisition, HR Operations and onboarding teams to ensure seamless candidate transitions


**Who You Are**
* Experience in offer management, appointment letter creation, or HR operational processes
* Strong knowledge of document validation, data verification, and compliance requirements
* Experience supporting audits and process governance activities
* Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to generate meaningful reports and insights
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with a focus on accuracy and service excellence
* Must Have Qualifications
+ MBA in Human Resources or equivalent qualification
+ Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
+ Experience in HR Operations or Talent Acquisition Operations

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to work within a global Talent Acquisition Centre of Excellence
* Exposure to recruitment operations, governance, compliance, and audit processes
* Hybrid working environment based at SP Infocity, Pune
* Collaboration with diverse stakeholders across HR and business functions
* Opportunity to contribute to process optimisation and operational excellence initiatives
* Experience working within a leading global telecommunications organisation


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced talent acquisition operations and offer management practices
* Recruitment governance and compliance management
* HR process auditing and control frameworks
* Data analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation
* Continuous improvement and operational excellence methodologies
* Stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Technical Recruiter – Pune, India
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India – Remote
 



**Working Hours:** 
 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST
 



**Compensation:** 
 Approximately ₹8\.6 lakh annually
 



**Experience:** 
 4\+ years, with strong technical recruiting experience
 



  





 ABOUT THIS ROLE
 



 This is
 **not a traditional Talent Acquisition role.** 




 We are not looking for someone to sit behind an ATS and process applications. We are looking for a
 **recruiting hunter** 
 —someone who believes the best candidates often aren't applying for jobs and knows how to go find them.
 



  





 At KIBO, every hire matters. Our recruiting strategy is simple:
 **identify exceptional people, engage them intelligently, tell the KIBO story, and get them interested in joining us.** 




 You will actively hunt for technical talent using LinkedIn, Naukri, professional networks, referrals, competitive intelligence, and whatever other creative methods help you find the right person. You will learn our technology, understand the companies where great candidates work, and become skilled at recognizing talent—not simply matching keywords on a résumé.
 



 If your recruiting strength is managing inbound applications, this probably isn't the right opportunity.
 



  





 If you believe you can find an exceptional candidate almost anywhere, start a conversation with them, earn their interest, and ultimately help close them—
 **we want to talk to you.** 




  





 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 


* Hunt for high\-quality technical talent rather than wait for candidates to apply
* Build targeted searches and talent maps across Pune, India, and other markets as needed
* Identify passive candidates working at companies with technologies and environments relevant to KIBO
* Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, professional networks, referrals, and creative sourcing techniques to uncover talent
* Engage passive candidates and create enough interest for them to have a conversation with KIBO
* Conduct effective recruiter screens and recognize aptitude, communication skills, motivation, and technical relevance
* Manage candidates from first contact through interviews, offer negotiation, acceptance, and onboarding
* Develop strong relationships with hiring managers and understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one
* Maintain an excellent candidate experience while keeping the recruiting process moving quickly
* Track sourcing activity, conversion rates, hires, and other recruiting metrics—and continuously improve your approach
* Learn the KIBO story well enough to sell the opportunity authentically and confidently



  





 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 



 We care about experience, but we care just as much about
 **intelligence, curiosity, drive, judgment, and resourcefulness.** 




 You should have:
 


* 4\+ years of recruiting experience, including meaningful experience recruiting technical talent
* Demonstrated success
 **proactively sourcing passive candidates**
* Experience recruiting engineers, architects, product or other technology professionals
* Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn Recruiter and other recruiting platforms
* **Conversational English and the confidence to communicate with candidates and executives globally**
* The ability to understand technical roles well enough to identify relevant candidates
* Strong interviewing and candidate\-assessment skills
* Persistence—you don't give up because the first search didn't produce the right candidate
* Curiosity and the ability to learn new technologies, companies, and talent markets quickly
* The confidence to approach people who aren't looking for a job and give them a reason to listen
* Strong organization and follow\-through
* The ability to work remotely during
 **3:00 PM–12:00 AM IST**



 Most importantly, you should have the mindset that
 **there is a great candidate out there somewhere, and your job is to find them.** 




  





 WHY KIBO?
 



 KIBO is a global composable commerce technology company helping B2C, D2C, and B2B organizations simplify complex commerce operations and deliver modern customer experiences.
 



 Our platform spans
 **Commerce, Order Management, and Subscriptions** 
 , and is trusted by brands including Ace Hardware, Zwilling, Jelly Belly, Nivel, and Honey Birdette.
 



 KIBO's technology is MACH Alliance Certified and has been recognized by Forrester, Gartner, IDC, Internet Retailer, and TrustRadius. KIBO was named a Leader in
 **The Forrester Wave™: Order Management Systems, Q1 2025** 
 and recognized in the
 **IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Enterprise Headless Digital Commerce Applications 2024 Vendor Assessment** 
 .
 



 For a recruiter, that gives you something important:
 **a story worth telling.** 




 We need someone smart and motivated enough to get that story in front of the right people.
 



  





 THIS ROLE MAY BE FOR YOU IF...
 



 You enjoy the hunt.
 



 You like figuring out where great people work and how to reach them.
 



 You aren't intimidated by a difficult search.
 



 You believe recruiting is part research, part sales, part judgment, and part persistence.
 



 And when a hiring manager says,
 **"This person is going to be hard to find,"** 
 your first reaction is:
 



**"I'll find them."**
