title: Recruiter
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Litmus is continuing to grow its Pune\-based GCC across engineering, product, customer success, and business operations. We’re looking for a Recruiter dedicated to supporting hiring in India and bringing strong knowledge of the local talent market to our global recruiting team.
   

  

 You’ll manage full\-cycle recruiting for roles across India, with direction and support from Litmus’s global Recruiter. Based in our Pune office, you’ll work closely with the Country Managing Director, People Operations, and hiring managers located across India and other regions. You’ll help ensure our global recruiting approach works effectively in India by sharing local market insights, adapting sourcing strategies, and creating a strong candidate experience.
   

  

****What you'll do****
* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for technical and business roles across India, from intake and sourcing through interviews, offers, and acceptance, while delivering a positive and consistent candidate experience.
* Build strong pipelines for specialized and difficult\-to\-fill positions, particularly across engineering, industrial software, product, and customer\-facing teams.
* Partner with hiring managers and the global Recruiter to understand role requirements, develop effective sourcing strategies, and adapt Litmus’s global recruiting processes for the India market.
* Apply strong knowledge of the India talent market to sourcing, candidate management, and offer discussions.
* Partner with People Operations on offers, background verification, and India\-specific hiring and compliance requirements.
* Build strong working relationships with the Country Managing Director and local teams through a regular presence in the Pune office.
* Maintain accurate candidate and hiring data in Ashby and provide regular updates on pipelines, challenges, and hiring progress.
* Coordinate with external agencies, job boards, and other recruiting partners when needed.


****What you'll bring****
* 5\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in India across technical and business roles.
* Demonstrated experience sourcing and hiring difficult\-to\-find technical talent.
* Strong knowledge of the India talent market, including common sourcing practices, notice periods, compensation structures, counteroffers, and candidate expectations.
* Working knowledge of India\-specific hiring compliance requirements and the judgment to partner with People Operations when guidance is needed.
* Experience collaborating with hiring managers and recruiting colleagues across countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Ability to manage multiple searches, balance competing priorities, and communicate progress clearly.
* Experience using an ATS and modern sourcing tools; experience with Ashby is highly preferred.
* Comfortable working regularly from Litmus’s Pune office while collaborating with remote global teams.


****Nice to have****
* Experience recruiting for an industrial software, IIoT, manufacturing technology, or other deep\-tech company.
* Experience recruiting for or supporting a GCC for a company headquartered outside India.

title: Recruitment Associate
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?** 




 The quality of school education available to students from low\-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high\-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.
 



  





 We run free and high\-impact schools and an exceptional college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world\-class professional development, our result\-oriented team culture, and our student\-centric school design. Read more about us at
 
 www.iTeachSchools.org
 
 .
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 The Recruitment Associate is a key member of the People Operations team and is responsible for building strong momentum around the secondary education movement and then leveraging it to find the best people for the organization. iTeach’s founding belief is “first who, then what” \- which means that we put all our bets on our people, making this role singularly important to the organization and the students’ success.
 



  





**Selection \& Sourcing \- 60%** 




  




* Drive the end\-to\-end sourcing and initial selection process for assigned roles, ensuring a strong and diverse candidate pipeline.
* Conduct CV screenings, phone/Video screenings and Walk\-ins to assess candidates against role requirements, competencies, and organizational values.
* Use multiple sourcing channels and recruitment portals effectively to identify and attract high\-potential candidates.
* Continuously experiment with innovative sourcing strategies and creative ways to reach and engage candidates, especially for hard\-to\-fill roles.
* Maintain strong candidate engagement, pool and momentum throughout the selection process.



  





**Interview Logistics \& Data Monitoring \- 20%** 




  




* Coordinate with the school Admin/ Principal for on ground interview logistics and ensure a smooth, timely, and positive experience for candidates and selectors.
* Work closely with selectors to ensure interviews are well planned, structured, and completed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment data across all stages of the hiring funnel.
* Use recruitment data and insights to support better decision\-making and continuously improve the hiring process.



  





**Recruitment Projects \& Process Improvement \- 20%**

**Org. \& Talent Consultant** 
 who provides end\-to\-end solutions and support inside the client to bring about real change – especially in the areas of
 **Org. Design, Performance \& Talent Management, Rewards Design** 









**Why this role exists** 




 At People Equation, we believe the best consulting involves not only solutioning but stays close enough to see change happen.
 



 Our consultants work alongside leadership teams and HR functions inside the client's context, helping solve organisation and talent challenges from diagnosis through implementation. We combine strategic thinking with operational capabilities and remain engaged until solutions become part of the way the organisation works.
 



  





 We call this our
 **Forward\-Deployed Consulting** 
 model.
 



  





 Our work for clients spans four interconnected dimensions:
 


* **Org. Design \& Talent Solutions —** 
 Design organisation structures and operating models, workforce planning, build job and career architecture, design performance \& talent management processes, and rewards design.
* **Deployment \& Change —** 
 Help organisations deploy the solutions and adopt, embed and sustain change through practical implementation, stakeholder engagement and capability building.
* **HR Partnering \& Operations —** 
 Work alongside client business and HR teams (as a project / in fractional capacity) to ensure operational efficiencies, compliant functioning, and the right culture and employee experience.
* **Recruitment —** 
 Strengthen organisations through executive search and recruitment advisory that ensure right people are in the right roles.



  





**What you'll do** 




 You'll work directly with client leadership on organisation and talent challenges. Your core work:
 


* **Organisation \& Operating Model Design** 
 — structure, spans and layers, role charters, design options and trade\-offs; and how work, decisions and accountabilities flow across the organisation
* **Workforce Planning** 
 — demand and supply modelling, productivity, cost\-to\-serve, build / buy / borrow choices
* **Performance \& Talent Management** 
 – philosophy \& process design, performance scorecards, performance \& potential assessment, talent review
* **Job Architecture and Career Frameworks** 
 — job families, job levelling, career architecture
* **Rewards Design** 
 — grades and bands, benchmarking, incentive and variable pay structures



  





 You may also contribute across the wider practice:
 


* Leadership development, culture and change
* HR transformation and fractional HR services (including operations, compliance)
* Learning and development
* Executive search and mid\-level recruitment, as part of broader client solutions



 Apart from project work, you will support client accounts, help strengthen the assets / IP of the practice, and build capability in fellow consultants.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 We're looking for consultants who enjoy solving business problems through people solutions. Typically, you'll bring:
 


* **4 \- 5 years of experience** 
 across HR consulting and HR COEs / business partnering
* Hands\-on project depth in organisation design, operating models, workforce planning, performance management, job architecture or compensation design.
* Practical exposure to HR operations and business partnering
* Working knowledge of executive search, recruitment or talent acquisition
* Strong facilitation, communication and structured problem\-solving skills
* Comfort with data — able to build and defend a model in Excel, and read market benchmarking well
* Intermediate or higher\-level skills in AI and the ability to leverage it to improve impact



  





**Success looks like** 




 Within your first year, you'll have:
 


* Led organisation design or workforce planning workstreams from diagnosis through implementation
* Delivered design artefacts clients actually adopt — structures, scorecards, architecture, pay frameworks
* Become a trusted advisor to multiple client leaders
* Delivered measurable business and people outcomes
* Contributed to People Equation's consulting IP and AI\-enabled ways of working
* Built lasting client relationships that lead to repeat opportunities



  





**What this role is not** 




 This isn't a strategy\-only consulting role, nor is it purely an HRBP, L\&D or recruitment role.
 



 It's for consultants who enjoy staying close to clients, solving real organisational problems through advisory \& services, and creating lasting change.

 Consultant, reporting to Partner

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Description** 




  





**The role** 




  





 You will own our most senior internal searches end to end, from first conversation with the candidate through to offer. The people you'll be hiring are directors and C\-level, so you are the first impression this company makes on them. You'll run intake directly with our founders and department heads, which includes telling them when the brief they've given you will not produce the hire they want.
 



  





 This is not a coordination role. It is not suited to someone who needs the search strategy decided before they start.
 



  





**Who We Are** 




  





 AI Acquisition is a multi\-8\-figure business helping founders and operators scale with AI. T vchousands of clients, hundreds of mastermind participants, with the US as our primary market. We're bootstrapped with no outside capital, so we set our own timelines and hire people who can operate without a script.
 



  





 Our Talent function was built from zero in the last fifteen months: ATS, AI screening gates, tiered assessment frameworks, and a hiring bar the founders now use. A delivery team handles high\-volume pipeline operations. You'll take whatever needs judgement, at any level, and you'll pick up the rest when the load demands it.
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Engagement and hours** 




  





 This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and statutory obligations in your country of residence.
 



 Expect a 50 to 60 hour week. Our team spans the UAE, the UK and the US, and this role holds the middle of that span. Your day starts on UAE business hours and runs into the US East Coast morning, with senior candidate calls landing outside conventional hours.
 



 We say this plainly because the people who do well here choose it. If you need fixed hours, this is not the right role and we would rather you know before you apply.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  




* The full range of searches, end to end, several at once. A C\-level hire and a junior specialist role in the same week, and both get done properly
* Pipeline building ahead of the requisition. Talent mapped, warmed and ready before the role opens, not scrambled when it does
* Candidate engagement over months, not days. Keeping strong people warm when there is nothing live for them, and giving them a reason to take your call the next time
* Employer brand in practice. Being able to answer "why would I leave what I have for AIA" with something specific and true, and building the narrative that makes senior people want the conversation
* Strategic advisory to hiring managers. Market reality, realistic timelines, what the role needs to pay, and when the brief they've written will not produce the hire they want
* Intake and calibration with founders and department heads, including the disagreement
* First contact with director and C\-level candidates, and being the reason they stay in process instead of going quiet
* Direct sourcing where no pipeline exists and inbound is useless
* Written candidate evaluations a founder can decide on without a follow\-up call
* Quality oversight on shortlists coming through the delivery team Testing what works. Running A/B on titles, post copy and channels, and making the call on what to keep based on quality of applicant rather than volume
* Assessment design and execution. Building and running structured evaluations, scorecards and one\-way assessments against a defined hiring bar, not judging on gut



  





**What You Need** 




  




* 6\+ years in talent acquisition, at least 3 of them in\-house, embedded or RPO. Agency\-only will not clear the bar
* Senior or leadership search experience. Volume\-only backgrounds are not a fit for this seat
* Demonstrable hiring into the US or UK market, representing an employer to candidates in that market
* Near\-native spoken and written English. You will improvise on camera with senior people, not read from notes
* Evidence of managing senior stakeholders, including disagreeing with them productively
* Direct sourcing that works, with response rates you can point to
* Comfortable operating as an independent contractor, invoicing monthly and managing your own tax position
* Real schedule flexibility across UAE, UK and US East Coast hours. Calls outside standard business hours are routine, not occasional
* Evidence of building talent pipelines ahead of demand, not only filling open roles reactively
* You have kept candidates engaged over months and converted them later. You can name one
* You can articulate an employer value proposition and adapt it by audience, rather than repeating the careers page
* Experience designing or running structured candidate assessments. Scorecards, structured interviews, work samples, psychometric or cognitive tools
* You have tested and iterated on your own job posts and can tell us what changed and what it produced
* An active, credible LinkedIn presence. You post, you engage, and people in your market know who you are. Passive profiles will not clear this bar



  





**What Stands Out** 




  




* Multi\-country or multi\-entity hiring
* You've built process, not only run someone else's
* You've been the only recruiter in the room and it was fine
* You've overseen or coached junior recruiters
* You've run A/B tests on titles, posts or channels and have the data to show for it
* AI\-assisted sourcing and outreach stack. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, or equivalent. Name what you've built with it, not what you've heard of
* You've built a talent pipeline that produced a hire months after the first conversation
* You've worked somewhere with no employer brand and had to create the reason people said yes



  





**Benefits** 




  





**What you get** 




  





**Up to $80K/Annually** 
 , as an independent contractor, based on experience
 



  





**Direct access to founders.** 
 You will sit in calibration with the people who make the decisions. No layers between you and the call
 



  





**A real AI stack, used daily.** 
 Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, LLM screening built into the workflow. You will use agents as part of the job, not as a side experiment, and you will have room to build your own
 



  





**A seat that rewards building.** 
 The function was built from zero in fifteen months. What you build here stays and gets used. If you want to inherit a finished process and maintain it, this is the wrong seat. If you want to put your own frameworks into a company that will actually run them, this is a rare one
 



  





**How We Hire** 




 Application, one\-way video, short written exercise, structured interview with our Global Head of People \& Talent, working session with a founder. You'll know where you stand at every stage.

 Surpluss is a B2B platform helping businesses source products and services at significantly better prices by connecting them with brands, manufacturers, distributors and surplus inventory.
 



 We are a growing company building a high\-performance team, and we are looking for an
 **HR Generalist** 
 who can take ownership of the HR function and help us build the people processes required to scale.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are looking for an
 **HR Generalist who can independently own HR end\-to\-end** 
 — from finding and hiring great people to onboarding, payroll coordination, employee management and HR operations.
 



 You will work directly with the founders and department heads and will be responsible for making HR work efficiently as the company grows.
 



**There is no HR lead above you for day\-to\-day guidance.** 
 We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make judgment calls, solve problems independently and build processes rather than simply execute instructions.
 



 This is an ideal role for someone who wants to grow into a
 **People/HR Manager** 
 role in a fast\-growing company.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition** 



* Understand hiring requirements from founders and department heads.
* Create compelling job descriptions and hiring briefs.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, job portals and other channels.
* Screen CVs and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Evaluate candidates for communication, culture fit, motivation and role suitability.
* Coordinate interviews and maintain a structured candidate pipeline.
* Manage candidate communication and follow\-ups throughout the hiring process.
* Handle offer discussions, negotiations and joining coordination.
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for recurring and future positions.
* Track hiring metrics such as time\-to\-hire, source of hire and offer\-to\-joining ratio.



  





**2\. Employee Onboarding \& Lifecycle** 



* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new employees.
* Collect and verify employee documentation.
* Prepare joining documentation, employee records and HR files.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure employees have the required access, equipment and information on joining.
* Conduct or coordinate employee induction.
* Explain company policies, processes and expectations to new employees.
* Track probation periods, confirmations, notice periods and other employee milestones.
* Conduct regular check\-ins with new employees during their initial months.



  





**3\. HR Operations \& Payroll** 



* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leave and employee information.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and ensure timely and accurate processing.
* Maintain salary, leave, attendance and employee documentation.
* Coordinate with external payroll/accounting consultants where required.
* Support statutory and HR compliance requirements.
* Maintain HR documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
* Prepare regular HR MIS and management reports.
* Identify gaps in HR operations and implement improvements.



  





**4\. Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Act as the first point of contact for employees for HR\-related queries.
* Build a strong relationship with employees across teams.
* Understand employee concerns and work with managers/founders to resolve them.
* Organise employee engagement activities, celebrations and team initiatives.
* Help build a positive, accountable and high\-performance work culture.
* Support employee feedback and engagement initiatives.



  





**5\. HR Policies \& Process Building** 




 You will play an important role in building the HR function as Surpluss scales.
 



 This includes:
 


* Recruitment and interview processes
* Employee onboarding and exit processes
* Leave and attendance policies
* HR policies and employee documentation
* Performance review processes
* Employee engagement programs
* HR dashboards and MIS
* Employee grievance and escalation processes
* HR systems and automation



  





 The expectation is not just to
 **maintain existing processes** 
 , but to identify what is missing and build better systems.
 



  





**What We're Looking for Must Have** 




  




* **2–4 years of experience in HR / People Operations.**
* Experience handling
 **end\-to\-end recruitment independently** 
 .
* Experience coordinating
 **monthly payroll** 
 and maintaining accurate payroll inputs.
* Experience managing employee onboarding and HR operations.
* Comfortable working with minimal supervision.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to confidently interact with candidates, employees, managers and founders.
* Strong organisational and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable handling multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and confidentiality.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Ability to solve problems independently rather than constantly escalate them.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience working in a startup or fast\-growing company.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Naukri and other recruitment platforms.
* Experience with HRMS / payroll software.
* Understanding of Indian employment and HR practices.
* Experience building HR policies and processes from scratch.
* Experience handling employee performance management or appraisal cycles.



  





**What We're Looking for in the Person** 




 This role is
 **not for someone looking for a purely administrative HR position.** 




 You should be someone who:
 


* Takes ownership without being chased.
* Can have difficult conversations professionally.
* Is comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for them.
* Can balance employee needs with business requirements.
* Notices problems before they become bigger problems.
* Is highly organised and follows through.
* Can work in an environment where processes are still being built.
* Enjoys building things rather than simply following established systems.
* Wants to grow with the company and eventually take larger ownership of the HR function.



  





**What You'll Get** 



* Direct exposure to the founders and leadership team.
* Ownership of the HR function as the company scales.
* Opportunity to build HR systems and processes from the ground up.
* Exposure to recruitment, people operations, employee engagement and organisational development.
* Significant opportunity to grow into a
 **People/HR Manager** 
 role.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern - Founder's Office
description:
For the kind of soul who finds energy in finding people, not just helping them get the job done.
 



 Recruiting is one of those crafts where most people are bad, very few are great, and the great ones quietly run the most important function in any growing company. Without the right people walking in, nothing else scales. Without speed, the right people walk out before they walk in.
 



 We are not great at this yet. We get hundreds of applicants per role, the leadership reviews most of them, and good candidates slip through because nobody got back to them in time. That is the gap this role is built to close.
 



  





**About The Test Tribe** 




 We are the world's largest Software Testing community turned Workforce Development Startup. 170K\+ members. 130\+ countries. 45\+ global chapters. Close to 1000 events done so far, including 30\+ large\-scale global conferences. We hold a high quality bar and we keep raising it. Products, services, flagship events, all of it.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is a Talent Acquisition internship role inside the Founder's Office.
 



 You work directly with the founder and leadership on every open role at TTT. Right now that means Business Development, Community, Founder's Office, and Operations hires. Tomorrow it will mean more.
 



 If you want a role that compresses 2 years of recruiting experience and learning into 3\-6 months, this is that role. And you can ask this to quite a few interns who walked the same path at TTT.
 



 Stipend: ₹10,000 to ₹20,000/month, based on what you bring to the table readily.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Source candidates daily across LinkedIn, Apollo, Internshala, Naukri, and college networks for 3 to 5 open roles at any time
* Run first\-pass screens on every applicant. Tag Good Fit, Maybe, Not a Fit. Surface the top 5 to 10 per role to the founder, weekly
* Own outbound cold emails, calls to candidates we want, not just inbound applicants we got
* Manage candidate communication end\-to\-end. Scheduling, follow\-ups, no\-show recovery, post\-interview feedback
* Own the recruiting tracker. One clean funnel dashboard per role, weekly Monday report
* Run employer branding lite. Careers page hygiene, candidate testimonial posts, founder\-led hiring posts on LinkedIn
* Daily leadership sync to share what is working, what is not, where the funnel is leaking



  





**Must\-Haves** 



* Strong written English, you will be writing cold InMails to VPs and warm replies to interns in the same hour
* Comfort with LinkedIn, Sheets/Notion, Calendly
* High ownership and speed, recruiting is a daily numbers game, not a weekly review
* Discipline in follow\-ups and documentation
* High reliability, should never need a follow\-up twice
* Working from Office, Baner, Pune, 5 days a week



  





**Nice To Have** 



* Prior sourcing or recruiting reps (college fest hiring, club hiring, internship hiring, freelance recruiting, any)
* Familiarity with Apollo, LinkedIn Recruiter, or any ATS
* Interest in B2B, SaaS, or startup ecosystem



  





**What You Get** 



* Speed: Learn high\-quality recruiting at pace
* Founder access: Daily, not weekly. Feedback in hours, not days
* Real ownership: You will close at least one hire in the first 6 weeks
* Tools provided: LinkedIn Recruiter, Apollo, ChatGPT Pro, Claude, Zoho, Calendly, Notion
* Good news: We don't treat interns as interns
* Bad news: We don't treat interns as interns



  





**Hiring Process** 



* 20\-minute screening call
* 30\-minute assignment (write 2 outbound messages and a candidate ranking) OR a video pitch on why you are the ideal candidate for this role
* 30\-minute founder round
* Offer or result within 3 working days



  





 This role is for a high\-ownership, structured, fast\-moving person who wants to learn recruiting as a craft, not as a checkbox. If that sounds like you, apply.
